column1: # How words are written, kanji or kana, by level (the japanese-notation pack,
# scripts/ja/build-japanese-notation.py). A row: the part written in kanji,
# the same part in kana, and the lowest level (1-5) at which the kana form is
# preferred; below 3 the kanji form is preferred under that level. Every
# dictionary word that differs only by that part, with the same reading and
# part of speech, takes the row (出来 でき: 出来る, 出来た, 出来ない).
# Level 3 follows 公用文における漢字使用等について (平成22年内閣訓令第1号);
# 4 the plainer writing 公用文作成の考え方 (令和4年) allows for 解説・広報;
# 5 the kana people often prefer in casual writing.
# Auxiliary verbs and formal nouns (動詞,非自立 / 名詞,非自立: 下さい, 頂く,
# 事, 物) are found by their part of speech at level 3, less the ones below.
# 4: plainer, as for explanations and public notices
# 5: kana often preferred in casual writing
